title: System prompt leakage
summary: LLM07. Make the planner recite its own instructions, then read what you got: every tool name, argument shape, and a dump-all SQL example. Detect the leak on output — and learn why the real fix is upstream.
takeaway: The system prompt is reconnaissance, not a secret store. Detect leaks, but never put anything there you wouldn't publish.
design_rule: Scan outbound responses for system-prompt disclosure; keep secrets and policy out of the prompt entirely.
